title: Full-stack web developer
tagline: From your first page to an app with a server and a database
description: Go one technology at a time: learn it from the start in its foundations repo, then prove it in the projects and bug hunts that follow. Each stage builds on the one before, so start at the top or skip what you already know.

title: AI engineer with TypeScript
tagline: Call models, ground them in your data, give them tools, and measure the result
description: Start with the language and async code, then build the pieces of a real LLM feature one at a time: model calls, retrieval, agents and evals, and finish with the bugs that show up in production.

title: Backend developer with Node.js
tagline: From the language to an API with a database behind it
description: Get solid in JavaScript and TypeScript, handle slow and failing services, build a JSON API with nothing but Node, learn the SQL behind it, and keep your history clean when things go wrong.

title: Frontend from the page up
tagline: A page people can use, the code that makes it move, then components
description: Start with a page that is well built and looks right on any screen, learn the language behind it, make the page respond in plain JavaScript, and finish by building a screen out of React components.

title: Interview prep
tagline: The language questions and the bug stories interviewers ask for
description: Get the language answers solid, then practice the debugging stories interviewers ask you to tell, in JavaScript and in LLM code.
